## Section 6: Unified Relative Score (URS) across all the candidate models {#sec-appendix6 .unnumbered}

```{r}
#| include: false

# Inv measures

inv_metrics_num <- read_rds(here::here('data/results/metrics_inv_num.rds')) |>
  unnest(loss_curve) |>
  mutate(model = case_when(model == 'lr' ~ 'Linear Regression',
                           model == 'lr_reg' ~ 'Censored Linear Regression',
                           model == 'moving_average' ~ 'Mean',
                           model == 'moving_average_reg' ~ 'Censored Mean',
                           model == 'naive' ~ 'Naive',
                           model == 'tckf' ~ 'TCKF',
                           model == 'arima' ~ 'ARIMA',
                           model == 'arima_reg' ~ 'Censored ARIMA',
                           model == 'ets' ~ 'ETS',
                           model == 'timegpt' ~ 'TimeGPT',
                           model == 'timegpt_reg' ~ 'Censored TimeGPT',
                           model == 'lgbm' ~ 'LightGBM',
                           model == 'lgbm_reg' ~ 'Censored LightGBM',
                           model == 'sba' ~ 'Syntetos-Boylan Approx'),
         model = factor(model,
                        levels = c("TCKF","Naive","Mean", 'Censored Mean', 'Syntetos-Boylan Approx', 'ETS', 'ARIMA', 'Censored ARIMA',
                                   'Linear Regression', 'Censored Linear Regression', 'LightGBM', 'Censored LightGBM',
                                   'TimeGPT', 'Censored TimeGPT'))) 

inv_metrics_emp <- read_rds(here::here('data/results/metrics_inv_emp.rds')) |> 
  unnest(loss_curve) |> 
  filter(model != 'site_system') |> 
  mutate(model = case_when(model == 'lr' ~ 'Linear Regression',
                           model == 'lr_reg' ~ 'Censored Linear Regression',
                           model == 'moving_average' ~ 'Mean',
                           model == 'moving_average_reg' ~ 'Censored Mean',
                           model == 'naive' ~ 'Naive',
                           model == 'tckf' ~ 'TCKF',
                           model == 'arima' ~ 'ARIMA',
                           model == 'arima_reg' ~ 'Censored ARIMA',
                           model == 'ets' ~ 'ETS',
                           model == 'timegpt' ~ 'TimeGPT',
                           model == 'timegpt_reg' ~ 'Censored TimeGPT',
                           model == 'lgbm' ~ 'LightGBM',
                           model == 'lgbm_reg' ~ 'Censored LightGBM',
                           model == 'sba' ~ 'Syntetos-Boylan Approx',
                           model == 'demand_planner' ~ 'Demand Planner',
                           model == 'system_gen' ~ 'System Generated'),
         model = factor(model,
                        levels = c("TCKF", 'Site ERP', 'System Generated', 'Demand Planner', "Naive","Mean", 'Censored Mean', 'Syntetos-Boylan Approx', 'ETS', 'ARIMA', 'Censored ARIMA',
                                   'Linear Regression', 'Censored Linear Regression', 'LightGBM', 'Censored LightGBM',
                                   'TimeGPT', 'Censored TimeGPT')))  

inv_metrics_num_summary <- inv_metrics_num |>
  group_by(policy, model, lambda) |>
  summarise(
    CSL = round(mean(CSL, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    stockout_rate = round(mean(stockout_rate, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    I_norm = round(mean(I_norm, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    avg_I = round(mean(avg_I, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    L = round(mean(L, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

inv_metrics_emp_summary <- inv_metrics_emp |>
  group_by(policy, model, lambda) |>
  summarise(
    CSL = round(mean(CSL, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    stockout_rate = round(mean(stockout_rate, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    I_norm = round(mean(I_norm, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    avg_I = round(mean(avg_I, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    L = round(mean(L, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

w_vector <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)

model_aggregates_num <- inv_metrics_num_summary |>
  group_by(policy, model) |>
  summarise(
    mean_stockout = mean(stockout_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Inorm    = mean(I_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

grand_averages_num <- model_aggregates_num |>
  group_by(policy) |>
  summarise(
    avg_all_stockout = mean(mean_stockout, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_all_Inorm    = mean(mean_Inorm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

urs_num <- model_aggregates_num |>
  left_join(grand_averages_num, by = c("policy")) |>
  crossing(w = w_vector) |> 
  mutate(
    rel_stockout = mean_stockout / (avg_all_stockout + 1e-6),
    rel_Inorm    = mean_Inorm / (avg_all_Inorm + 1e-6),
    urs = sqrt(w * rel_stockout^2 + (1 - w) * rel_Inorm^2)
  ) |>
  group_by(model, policy, w) |>
  summarise(
    urs_mean = round(mean(urs, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

model_aggregates_emp <- inv_metrics_emp_summary |>
  group_by(policy, model) |>
  summarise(
    mean_stockout = mean(stockout_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Inorm    = mean(I_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

grand_averages_emp <- model_aggregates_emp |>
  group_by(policy) |>
  summarise(
    avg_all_stockout = mean(mean_stockout, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_all_Inorm    = mean(mean_Inorm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

urs_emp <- model_aggregates_emp |>
  left_join(grand_averages_emp, by = c("policy")) |>
  crossing(w = w_vector) |> 
  mutate(
    rel_stockout = mean_stockout / (avg_all_stockout + 1e-6),
    rel_Inorm    = mean_Inorm / (avg_all_Inorm + 1e-6),
    urs = sqrt(w * rel_stockout^2 + (1 - w) * rel_Inorm^2)
  ) |>
  group_by(model, policy, w) |>
  summarise(
    urs_mean = round(mean(urs, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-num_urs_1
#| tbl-cap: "Overall Unified Relative Score (URS) across all evaluated replenishment policies for the numerical experiment. (Part 1)"
#| tbl-pos: 'H'

urs_num_wide <- urs_num |>
  filter(!policy %in% c('capped', 'oracle', 
                                   'upper_q80', 'upper_q85', 'upper_q90', 'upper_q95')) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  mutate(policy = factor(policy,
                        levels = c("deterministic", 'myopic (k=5)', 'myopic (k=10)', 'myopic (k=20)'))) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols    = model,
    names_from = c(policy, w),
    values_from = urs_mean,
    names_glue = "{policy}_{w}"  
  )

colnames(urs_num_wide) <- c(
  "Method",
  # deterministic
  "w=0.1", 'w=0.25', 'w=0.5', 'w=0.75', 'w=0.9',
  # myopic (k=5)
  "w=0.1", 'w=0.25', 'w=0.5', 'w=0.75', 'w=0.9',
  # myopic (k=10)
  "w=0.1", 'w=0.25', 'w=0.5', 'w=0.75', 'w=0.9',
  # myopic (k=20)
  "w=0.1", 'w=0.25', 'w=0.5', 'w=0.75', 'w=0.9'
)

urs_num_wide |>
  knitr::kable(booktabs = T, linesep = "") |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 6, latex_options = "scale_down") |>
  landscape() |>
  add_header_above(c(
    " " = 1,
    "Deterministic" = 5,
    "Myopic (k=5)" = 5,
    "Myopic (k=10)" = 5,
    "Myopic (k=20)" = 5
  )) 

```
